name: sparepage
description: SparePage: an eco-formatting assistant for Google Docs. Flags wasteful print formatting and suggests paper and ink saving fixes you accept one at a time.

scripts.site:build: vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts --mode addin && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts --mode home && node scripts/addin-manifest.mjs
scripts.addin:dev: SITE_URL=https://localhost:3000 npm run site:build && node scripts/addin-dev-server.mjs

author: Manav Purswani and Cata Gamero
